show.name: Dororo
show.summary: A samurai lord has bartered away his newborn son's organs to forty-eight demons in exchange for dominance on the battlefield. Yet, the abandoned infant survives thanks to a medicine man who equips him with primitive prosthetics—lethal ones with which the wronged son will use to hunt down the multitude of demons to reclaim his body one piece at a time, before confronting his father. On his journeys the young hero encounters an orphan who claims to be the greatest thief in Japan.

show.name: Zorro
show.summary: A reinvention of the iconic Disney action-adventure-western series Zorro, with Wilmer Valderrama starring as Don Diego de la Vega and his dashing swashbuckling alter ego, the masked horseman named Zorro.

show.name: Zorro
show.summary: Diego de la Vega returns to California to avenge his father's murder. After assuming the title of Zorro, he initiates his struggle against Nah-Lin, a Native American who he believes has stolen his inheritance. Diego will confront the Governor, the malevolent leader of the Chinese community and a secret society, placing the common good above all. In doing so, he will sacrifice his love for Lola.

show.name: Zorro
show.summary: Zorro was set in Spanish California, this often-refilmed story chronicles the adventures of Don Diego de la Vega, a young nobleman who lives a double live as El Zorro ('the Fox'), protector of the people of the Pueblo de Los Angeles during the early 1800s. Hiding behind the mannerisms of a bookish fop, Diego keeps his second identity hidden from everyone but his servant, Felipe. Zorro's greatest enemy is always the Alcalde, who personifies the distant Spanish government in Los Angeles. Cantina-owner (and independent woman far ahead of her time) Victoria Escalante provides the love interest.

show.name: Zorro
show.summary: In the early nineteenth century, back from Spain, where he was studying, Don Diego de la Vega discovers that Los Angeles is tyrannized by the garrison commander of this small town of Spanish California. The young nobleman decides to fight these abuses of power and takes up arms in the name of Zorro (Spanish for fox), a masked horseman dressed in black. Don Diego is assisted by his faithful mute servant Bernardo, who is in secret, and his black horse, Tornado.

show.name: Zorro
show.summary: In Zorro, a young Latinx woman discovers that her long-deceased father was the legendary hero Zorro. She takes on his masked persona to defend the desperate citizens of her Austin, Texas community from the wealthy forces seeking to exploit them.

show.name: Zorro
show.summary: Don Diego de la Vega opposes the corrupt tyrants of Spanish California as the masked swordsman, Zorro.

show.name: DogBro
show.summary: Meen, a fifth-year medical student, cherishes a studious life filled with the joyful company of friends like Bon, Flint, Kim, Baikhao, and Pokpong. One day, Meen's mother sends Tul, the son of her close friend, who has recently passed the entrance exam to pursue engineering at Chiang Mai University, the top-ranked institution in the country, to live with Meen and assigns Meen to take care of Tul. Meen sees this as a good opportunity for him to move to a dorm near the university and have Tul take care of Nirand instead. But before moving out, Meen learns that behind Tul's excellence as a student lies a struggle with depression. Driven by his medical training and compassion, Meen makes the selfless choice to abandon the dormitory plan to support and care for Tul. As they live together for a while, their relationship develops beyond just "brothers." Both must choose between a romantic relationship or ending it as mere "brothers" to fulfill their life goals.

show.name: Zorro
show.summary: In 1821, Don Diego de la Vega became mayor of his beloved city of Los Angeles, which he intends to make prosper. However, the municipality is facing financial problems due to the greed of a local businessman, Don Emmanuel, in the face of whom the mayor's powers are insufficient to fight injustice. Diego has not used his double Zorro for 20 years. But in the name of the general interest, he has no choice but to bring out his mask and sword. Very quickly, Diego will encounter difficulties in reconciling his dual identity of Zorro and mayor, which puts a strain on his marriage to Gabriella, who ignores his secret. Will Diego be able to save his marriage and mental health in the midst of chaos?
